Chapter 6 - Types, Constants, and Global Functions / Types and Constants

Cyberdog File Creator

The following constants represents creators used by Cyberdog.
kCyberdogCreator
Creator used internally by Cyberdog.
kNavigatorCreator
Creator used to qualify commands sent by a navigator to its embedded display part's HandleCommand method.
